# ✉️ City Council Meeting
*Your quick guide to what's on the City Council agenda — September 3, 2025*

## 🗣️ How to Participate
- **Meeting:** [Wednesday, September 3 at 3:00 PM](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&text=City%20Council%20Meeting&dates=20250903T150000Z/20250903T170000Z&location=Tour%20starts%20in%20the%20Recycling%20Center%20Office%20Lobby.%2C%207501%20Schmidt%20Lane&details=City%20Council%20Meeting%20in%20El%20Cerrito) 📅
- **Where:** Tour starts in the Recycling Center Office Lobby., 7501 Schmidt Lane
- **Watch Online:** Not specified.
- **Call In:** Not specified.
- **Email Comments:** Not specified. — **deadline:** Not specified.
- **Attend & Speak:** Check meeting agenda for public comment rules
- **Full Agenda:** [View original meeting agenda](https://www.el-cerrito.org/Calendar.aspx)

## 🚨 What's on the Agenda
### Recycling + Environmental Resource Center Public Tour
- **Change:** Free Public Tour of the City of El Cerrito Recycling + Environmental Resource Center for individuals and small groups. Group tours can be scheduled at other times for a fee. RSVP by email or phone is required.
- **Impact:** Increased public awareness and civic knowledge. Cost not specified.
- **Action:** RSVP by email or phone is required

## ✅ Bottom Line
Found 34 civic engagement opportunities in El Cerrito's calendar. Participate in the City Council meeting to stay informed and involved in local governance.

⚡ *Independent and nonpartisan summary. Facts only; no spin.*
